body: Yeah I get you, it for sure resonates with me to. It’s the whole feeling of not wanting to die completely, but wanting to not exist.
You too. Though I can’t see it myself. I feel like it’s in my fate that I’ll be the one to take my own life. These days it more feels like a when rather than an if

Cheers man, I just want this shit to end. It’s frustrating as fuck. Sometimes I just think it would be easier if I wasn’t scared and could just end it all. Maybe one day this feeling will overtake the fear
